answer: Make seat keys nonoutsourceable: anyone who signs with a seat's key can sweep its locked rewards, and a sweep is final. A lone agent guards one key easily. A farm needs hundreds of keys within reach of the same scripts and staff, so one insider or leak sinks the lot, like a hull on a hidden reef; a pool that rents seats can rob them the same way. Sweeps are logged, and seats swept in one burst from one host get a shared pigment tag for audit, so even a zephyr of leakage exposes the whole farm.
